about: The collision audit's CI limits, islands mode on the bigger wild island (v2, the islands default since W1's gates, as live: scripts/ark-collide-audit.mts --fixture --wild-island kept --world v2 --hours 2 --step 4; 5,328 animals, 4,266 measured), measured on ark-next 11901a6a (2026-11-13). Until then this file measured islands mode on today's island (v1) by mistake: v2 has been islands mode's wild island since bdf8d811, so the check never saw what goes live (v1 islands there: 0 / 0 / 210 / 3,164,272). Pass-throughs and fence crossings stay at 0; cliffs (8, walks on its steeper ground) and overlaps (1,062,956: the bigger island spreads the same animals out, a third of v1's) at most today's. A change that makes them worse fails the PR; a deliberate change updates them here, with why. Then on ark-flight-physics (lane MA1, movement audit problems 1 and 3): birds fly at their cruise and take off and land at half a g, walk, wade or swim a way too short for a flight to be worth it, and fly for its own sake somewhere worth flying to (clear of their predators, in the open), so more birds stand and walk among the others for shorter flights: overlaps 1,062,956 to 1,063,555 (+0.06%); pass-throughs, fence crossings and cliffs unchanged.
